requiredLinuxCells.result: FAIL on chromium and firefox at line 142: toHaveAccessibleName('Markdown editor source') received 'Markdown \u6e90\u7801\u7f16\u8f91\u533a'; WebKit external-blocked
requiredLinuxCells.platformReason: Pre-existing baseline mismatch on main c86b5d29, not caused by this delivery. The transaction fixture binds :locale-text="markdownCommandLocaleText", which is undefined for the spec URL (no markdownCommandLocale query param), so the component uses defaultMarkdownEditorLocaleText whose textarea labels are Chinese by design (the repo default locale is zh-CN). The spec hardcodes the English accessible name. This is ambiguous between a stale spec expectation and an intended locale-independent English accessible-name contract (the merged #664 writing-aids a11y artifact records the English name from a different fixture). #398 forbids sneakily modifying production/tests in an evidence task, so this is surfaced for a separate fix decision, not patched here. The functional Source/Live single-authority behaviour is independently REAL-green via the unit tests and the :39/:104 browser cells; only the accessible-name string assertion fails.
